name: Machinae Fractus

bonuses.name: Beyond Human Frailties
bonuses.text: Ignore penalties for being Heavily Injured

abilities.name: Cybernetic Abomination
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 2 Fear Test
If anybody reaches Dying within 3m of a Fractus, the Fractus may immediately pick them up and make a Movement Action to carry them away

note: Crude Augmetic Limb prints 'Unwieldy 1' (stored Unwieldy (1)). Faction heretic by the CHAOS and HERETIC keywords, though it also prints ADEPTUS MECHANICUS.
